text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert — elevated 503/429 ratio detected for service `inference-proxy` in us-east-1. 5m 503 rate=18% (baseline 0.5%). Spikes correlated with heavy embeddings traffic from tenant-42 and tenant-99. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/r/redwood/503s?range=5m

alex: ack, I'm oncall. paging maya and leo.

maya: oncall here, looking. can someone drop the grafana panel link?

leo: grabbing logs now — tailing proxy errors: `upstream read timeout` and `502 bad gateway` in front of model-router. suspicious KV-cache misses growing.

ingrid: quick mitigation proposal: per-tenant QPS cap on tenant-42 & 99 to 20qps, disable rerank-experiment for those tenants, and route a small % to fallback smaller model. will run in sequence to avoid cascade.

sam: +1. runbook suggests `apply-tenant-cap` then `disable-feature` then `fallback-route`. runbook snippet:```bash
infractl ratecap set --tenant tenant-42 --qps 20 --scope proxy --reason "503 spike"
infractl ratecap set --tenant tenant-99 --qps 20 --scope proxy --reason "503 spike"
flagsctl disable --flag rerank-experiment --tenants tenant-42,tenant-99
routerctl route --tenant tenant-42 --percent 5 --model small-1
```

alex: executing now. applying tenant caps. ops-bot pls run those commands and report back.

ops-bot: Executing: `infractl ratecap set --tenant tenant-42 --qps 20 --scope proxy` — done. returned 200.

ops-bot: Executing: `infractl ratecap set --tenant tenant-99 --qps 20 --scope proxy` — done.

ops-bot: Executing: `flagsctl disable --flag rerank-experiment --tenants tenant-42,tenant-99` — done.

ops-bot: Executing: `routerctl route --tenant tenant-42 --percent 5 --model small-1` — done.

carol: CSM notified for both tenants. email + slack DM sent to account owners, asked to expect degraded throughput for ~15-30m while we stabilize.

leo: monitoring metrics — 503 rate dropped from 18% -> 6% in the 2m after caps. 429s increased from 0.2% -> 2.1% for tenant-42. likely client retries hitting the cap.

maya: that's expected. prefer small transient 429s over sustained 503s. keep an eye on retry storms.

alex: can we throttle retries at the proxy layer? add short `Retry-After` header?

ingrid: added conservative 5s `Retry-After` for tenant-42 & 99 at proxy. policy push id: p-4582.

ops-bot: Policy applied. `Retry-After` header now returned for 429s (5s).

sam: also lowered burst allowance for those tenants to avoid token bucket refill spikes: `infractl bucket set --tenant tenant-42 --burst 5` — applied.

leo: metrics 5m window: 503s down to 1.8%, 429s stable at ~2.3% and tail latencies for routed small-1 increased slightly (+40ms) but within SLO.

alex: good. I'm going to update the incident record: INC-2026 created, severity: P2 (customer impact, partial). summary: transient high 503s caused by heavy embeddings traffic -> applied tenant caps, disabled rerank-experiment, routed 5% to fallback, added Retry-After, lowered burst.

maya: flagging follow-ups: - run postmortem to determine root (cache pressure vs model-backend scaling) - consider autoscale knobs on model-router for embeddings path - more gradual rollout for rerank-experiment for heavy-traffic tenants

carol: customer comms drafted, sending now. template: "We've applied temporary caps and will restore once stable. We'll follow up with RCA."

leo: one more check — observed increased KV-cache miss-rate on the heavy shard. opening ticket for cache sizing: CH-674.

ingrid: note: we should re-evaluate cap after 30m, ramp back slowly: plan: 20->40->80 qps over 10m steps if 503s remain <1%.

alex: handing over active watch to maya for the next 30m. if 503 >5% or 429 >10% for a sustained 3m, page me.

maya: taking it. will monitor panels, logs, and the routing queue. I have escalation list and contact info in the incident doc.

ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled rollback window in 40m.

maya: thanks. adding action items to incident doc and marking mitigations applied. will update last_message_ts when I sign off.

alex: thx team. :thumbsup:
